verses.sloka: देव देवे गते तस्मिन् सो अंगुष्ठ अग्र निपीडिताम् ।कृत्वा वसुमतीम् राम वत्सरम् समुपासत ॥१-४३-१॥
verses.transliteration: deva deve gate tasmin so aṁguṣṭha agra nipīḍitām ।kṛtvā vasumatīm rāma vatsaram samupāsata ॥1-43-1॥

translations.english: "O Rama when that God of the gods (Brahma) departed, Bhagiratha, pressing the earth with the tip of his big toe (standing supported by the big toe) penanced (meditated upon Siva) for one year.
translations.hindi: — एकचल्वारिंश: सग; oe ुत्रांश्चिरगताञज्ञात्या सगरो रघुनन्दन । नप्तारमत्रवीद्राजा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा

verses.sloka: अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सर्व लोक नमस्कृतः ।उमापतिः पशुपती राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४३-२॥
verses.transliteration: atha saṁvatsare pūrṇe sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ ।umāpatiḥ paśupatī rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-43-2॥

translations.english: After one full year was completed, Iswara who is worshipped by all in all the worlds said to king Bhagiratha:
translations.hindi: हे वत्स ! तुम शूरवीर हो, विद्वान्‌ हो ओर अपने पूर्वजों के -समान तेजस्वी भी हो । जाकर अपने पिठुव्यों ( चाचाओं ) का और घोड़ा चुराने वाले का पता लगाओ ;

verses.sloka: प्रीतः ते अहम् नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम् ।शिरसा धारयिष्यामि शैलराज सुताम् अहम् ॥१-४३-३॥
verses.transliteration: prītaḥ te aham naraśreṣṭha kariṣyāmi tava priyam ।śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi śailarāja sutām aham ॥1-43-3॥

translations.english: "O Best of men I am pleased with your devotion. I will hold Ganga on my head, the daughter of the king of mountains (to reduce the force of her descent). I shall do your wish.
translations.hindi: इस प्रथ्वी के भीतर बलों में बड़े-बड़े पराक्रमी जीवधारी हैं । अतः उनको हराने के लिए तलवार व धनुष बाण लिए रहो

verses.sloka: ततो हैमवती ज्येष्ठा सर्व लोक नमस्कृता ।तदा सा अति महत् रूपम् कृत्वा वेगम् च दुःसहम् ॥१-४३-४॥
verses.transliteration: tato haimavatī jyeṣṭhā sarva loka namaskṛtā ।tadā sā ati mahat rūpam kṛtvā vegam ca duḥsaham ॥1-43-4॥

translations.english: Then Ganga, the eldest daughter of Himavat who is adored by all the worlds, assuming the form of a mighty river descended from the sky with unbearable speed on the auspicious head of Siva.
translations.hindi: जो वन्दना करने योग्य पुरुष मिलें, उनको प्रणाम करना और जो विन्नकारक' हों उनका वध करना । इस प्रकार कार्य सिद्ध कर -लौटना, जिससे ( अधूरा ) यज्ञ पूरा हो

verses.sloka: आकाशात् अपतत् राम शिवे शिव शिरस्य् उत ।अचिन्तयः च सा देवी गंग परम दुर्धरा ॥१-४३-५॥
verses.transliteration: ākāśāt apatat rāma śive śiva śirasy uta ।acintayaḥ ca sā devī gaṁga parama durdharā ॥1-43-5॥

translations.english: "Goddess Ganga, extremely difficult to contain, thought that seizing Siva with her flow she would enter the lower regions of the earth.

verses.sloka: विशामि अहम् हि पातालम् स्त्रोतसा गृह्य शंकरम् ।तस्याः वलेपनम् ज्ञत्व क्रुद्धः तु भगवन् हरः ॥१-४३-६॥
verses.transliteration: viśāmi aham hi pātālam strotasā gṛhya śaṁkaram ।tasyāḥ valepanam jñatva kruddhaḥ tu bhagavan haraḥ ॥1-43-6॥

translations.english: Then the threeeyed Lord Siva, aware of her proud intentions applied his intelligence to conceal her.
translations.hindi: बालकाण्डे | द महाराज की आज्ञा के अनुसार वह उस मागे पर जा पहुंचा: जसे उसके पितृव्यों ने खोद कर बनाया था और उस मागे से पाताल में पहुँच गया

verses.sloka: तिरोभावयितुम् बुद्धिम् चक्रे त्रिनयनः तदा ।सा तस्मिन् पतिता पुण्या पुण्ये रुद्रस्य मूर्धनि॥१-४३-७॥
verses.transliteration: tirobhāvayitum buddhim cakre trinayanaḥ tadā ।sā tasmin patitā puṇyā puṇye rudrasya mūrdhani॥1-43-7॥

translations.english: O Rama that sacred river (Ganga), descended on to the depths of the matted locks on the holy head of Siva resembling the mount Himavan.
translations.hindi: देव, दानव, यक्ष, राक्षस, पिशाच और नाग--मार्ग में जो-जो मिलता वही इसका आदर-सत्कार करता । जाते-जाते महातेजस्वी; अंशुमान ने एक दिग्गज को देखा

verses.sloka: हिमवत् प्रतिमे राम जटा मण्डल गह्वरे ।सा कथंचित् महीम् गंतुम् न अशक्नोत् यत्नम् आस्थिता ॥१-४३-८॥
verses.transliteration: himavat pratime rāma jaṭā maṇḍala gahvare ।sā kathaṁcit mahīm gaṁtum na aśaknot yatnam āsthitā ॥1-43-8॥

translations.english: Trapped in the matted locks, she (Ganga) could not come out. With all her efforts she could not reach the earth.
translations.hindi: उस दिग्गज की परिक्रमा कर तथा उससे शिष्टाचार की बातें कर, अर्थात्‌ कुशल प्रश्नादि कर, अंशुमान ने उस दिमाज से अपने चाचाओं का और घोड़े के हरने वाले का पता पूछा

verses.sloka: न एव सा निर्गमम् लेभे जटा मण्डल अंततः ।तत्र एव आबंभ्रमत् देवी संवत्सर गणान् बहून् ॥१-४३-९॥
verses.transliteration: na eva sā nirgamam lebhe jaṭā maṇḍala aṁtataḥ ।tatra eva ābaṁbhramat devī saṁvatsara gaṇān bahūn ॥1-43-9॥

translations.english: There the golden Ganga wandered about for many years. Bhagiratha not finding Ganga, once again resorted to great penance.

verses.sloka: ताम् अपश्यन् पुनः तत्र तपः परमम् आस्थितः ।स तेन तोषितः च असीत् अत्यंतम् रघुनंदन ॥१-४३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tām apaśyan punaḥ tatra tapaḥ paramam āsthitaḥ ।sa tena toṣitaḥ ca asīt atyaṁtam raghunaṁdana ॥1-43-10॥

translations.english: O Son of the Raghus (Rama) Siva was immensely pleased with the penace and thereafter released Ganga (drop by drop) forming Bindusara.

verses.sloka: विससर्ज ततो गंगाम् हरो बिन्दु सरः प्रति ।तस्यम् विसृउज्यमानायाम् सप्त स्रोतंसि जज्ञिरे ॥१-४३-११॥
verses.transliteration: visasarja tato gaṁgām haro bindu saraḥ prati ।tasyam visṛujyamānāyām sapta srotaṁsi jajñire ॥1-43-11॥

translations.english: As she (Ganga) was released, she branched out into seven streams. Three streams known as Hladini, Pavani and Nalini having auspicious waters and conferring prosperity flowed eastwards.

verses.sloka: ह्लादिनी पावनी चैव नलिनी च तथा एव च ।तिस्रः प्राचीम् दिशम् जग्मुः गंगाः शिव जलाः शुभाः ॥१-४३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: hlādinī pāvanī caiva nalinī ca tathā eva ca ।tisraḥ prācīm diśam jagmuḥ gaṁgāḥ śiva jalāḥ śubhāḥ ॥1-43-12॥

translations.english: As she (Ganga) was released, she branched out into seven streams. Three streams known as Hladini, Pavani and Nalini having auspicious waters and conferring prosperity flowed eastwards.
translations.hindi: उनके इस प्रकार के वचन सुन, अंशुमान शीघ्र वहाँ पहुँच गया, जहाँ सगर के पुत्र और उसके चाचा के भस्म किए हुए' शरीर की राख का ढेर पड़ा था

verses.sloka: सुचक्षुः च एव सीता च सिन्धुः च एव महानदी ।तिस्रः एता दिशम् जग्मुः प्रतीचीम् तु शुभ उदकाः ॥१-४३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sucakṣuḥ ca eva sītā ca sindhuḥ ca eva mahānadī ।tisraḥ etā diśam jagmuḥ pratīcīm tu śubha udakāḥ ॥1-43-13॥

translations.english: Auspicious Suchakshu, Sita and a great river Sindhu, these three great rivers flowed westwards.

verses.sloka: सप्तमी च अन्वगात् तासम् भगीरथ रथम् तदा ।भगीरथो अपि रजर्षि दिव्यम् स्यंदनम् आस्थितः ॥१-४३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: saptamī ca anvagāt tāsam bhagīratha ratham tadā ।bhagīratho api rajarṣi divyam syaṁdanam āsthitaḥ ॥1-43-14॥

translations.english: The seventh stream among them followed Bhagiratha. The most brilliant rajarshi Bhagiratha also mounting on divine chariot raced forward and Ganga followed him.
translations.hindi: दःख-शोकातुर अंशुमान ने समीप ही यज्ञीय अश्व को भी: चरते हुए देखा

verses.sloka: प्रायात् अग्रे महातेजा गंग तम् च अपि अनुव्रजत् ।गगनात् शंकर शिरः ततो धरणिम् आगता ॥१-४३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: prāyāt agre mahātejā gaṁga tam ca api anuvrajat ।gaganāt śaṁkara śiraḥ tato dharaṇim āgatā ॥1-43-15॥

translations.english: From the sky on to the head of Shankara and thence Ganga resorted to the earth. There it flowed forward with a roaring sound.

verses.sloka: असर्पत जलम् तत्र तीव्र शब्द पुरस्कृतम् ।मत्स्य कच्छप संघैः च शिशुमार गणैः तथा ॥१-४३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: asarpata jalam tatra tīvra śabda puraskṛtam ।matsya kacchapa saṁghaiḥ ca śiśumāra gaṇaiḥ tathā ॥1-43-16॥

translations.english: Then the earth looked bright with the fallen and falling shoals of fish, turtles and multitudes of other seaanimals.
translations.hindi: अंशुमान उसे देख बहुत दुःखी हुआ और उनकी मृत्यु पर शोकान्वित हो रोने लगा

verses.sloka: पतद्भिः पतितैः च एव व्यरोचत वसुंधरा ।ततो देव ऋषि गंधर्वा यक्ष सिद्ध गणाः तथा ॥१-४३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: patadbhiḥ patitaiḥ ca eva vyarocata vasuṁdharā ।tato deva ṛṣi gaṁdharvā yakṣa siddha gaṇāḥ tathā ॥1-43-17॥

translations.english: Then devarshis, gandharvas, yakshas and hosts of siddhas looked on with astonishment at Ganga falling from the sky and descending on the earth.
translations.hindi: गरुड़ जी ने अंशुमान से कहा, हे पुरुपसिंह ! तुम दुःखी मत 'हो । क्योंकि इन सब का वध लोकसम्मत ही हुआ है

verses.sloka: व्यलोकयन्त ते तत्र गगनात् गाम् गताम् तदा ।विमानैः नगर आकारैः हयैः गज वरैः तथा ॥१-४३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: vyalokayanta te tatra gaganāt gām gatām tadā ।vimānaiḥ nagara ākāraiḥ hayaiḥ gaja varaiḥ tathā ॥1-43-18॥

translations.english: Then, gods in a state of excitement in their aerial chariots as large as cities, on horses and on big elephants were stationed there (in the sky).
translations.hindi: ये सब अचिन्त्य प्रभाव वाले महात्मा कपिल द्वारा भस्म किये गए हैं । हे प्राज्ञ ! इनको लौकिक ( साधारण ) जलदान मत करो । अर्थात्‌ कूप तड़ाग के साधारण जल से इनका तर्पण सत -करो

verses.sloka: पारिप्लव गताः च अपि देवताः तत्र विष्ठिताः ।तत् अद्भुततमम् लोके गंगा अवतरम् उत्तमम् ॥१-४३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: pāriplava gatāḥ ca api devatāḥ tatra viṣṭhitāḥ ।tat adbhutatamam loke gaṁgā avataram uttamam ॥1-43-19॥

translations.english: Gods with great lustre arrived to witness the most wonderful, grand descent of Ganga.

verses.sloka: दिदृक्षवो देव गणाः समीयुः अमित ओजसः ।संपतद्भिः सुर गणैः तेषाम् च आभरण ओजसा ॥१-४३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: didṛkṣavo deva gaṇāḥ samīyuḥ amita ojasaḥ ।saṁpatadbhiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ teṣām ca ābharaṇa ojasā ॥1-43-20॥

translations.english: The cloudless sky shone with the radiance of the ornaments of the gods alighting speedily to witness Ganga. It appeared as though the sky was filled with a hundred Suns.
translations.hindi: जब लोकपावनी गङ्गा जी के जल से इनकी भस्म तर होगी ( अथोत्‌ केवल तपेण से ही काम न चलेगा )

verses.sloka: शत आदित्यम् इव आभाति गगनम् गत तोयदम् ।शिंशुमार उरग गणैः मीनैः अपि च चंचलैः ॥१-४३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: śata ādityam iva ābhāti gaganam gata toyadam ।śiṁśumāra uraga gaṇaiḥ mīnaiḥ api ca caṁcalaiḥ ॥1-43-21॥

translations.english: The sky strewn with lightnings appeared as if it was inhabited by seaanimals, serpents and fishes fickle.
translations.hindi: तब साठ हजार राजकुमार स्वर्गवासी होंगे । हे महाभाग ! है पुरुषोत्तम ! तुम घोड़ा ले कर लोट जाओ

verses.sloka: विद्युद्भिः इव विक्षिप्तैः आकाशम् अभवत् तदा ।पाण्डुरैः सलिल उत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा ॥१-४३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vidyudbhiḥ iva vikṣiptaiḥ ākāśam abhavat tadā ।pāṇḍuraiḥ salila utpīḍaiḥ kīryamāṇaiḥ sahasradhā ॥1-43-22॥

translations.english: White foams of water were scattered in a thousand ways. It appeared as if the sky was spread over with autumnal clouds flocks of swans.

verses.sloka: शारद अभ्रैः इव आक्रीणम् गगनम् हंस संप्लवैः ।क्वचित् द्रुततरम् याति कुटिलम् क्वचित् आयतम् ॥१-४३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: śārada abhraiḥ iva ākrīṇam gaganam haṁsa saṁplavaiḥ ।kvacit drutataram yāti kuṭilam kvacit āyatam ॥1-43-23॥

translations.english: Ganga was flowing now rapid, now slow, now wide, now meandering, now low, now high.

verses.sloka: विनतम् क्वचित् उद्धूतम् क्वचित् याति शनैः शनैः ।सलिलेन एव सलिलम् क्वचित् अभ्याहतम् पुनः ॥१-४३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: vinatam kvacit uddhūtam kvacit yāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।salilena eva salilam kvacit abhyāhatam punaḥ ॥1-43-24॥

translations.english: Sometimes waves dashed against waves. They rose repeatedly upwards and fell down on the ground.
translations.hindi: उनको गरुड़ जी की कही सब बातें सुनाई । अंशुमान की उन दारुण बातों को सुन, महाराज सगर बहुत दुखी हुए

verses.sloka: मुहुर् ऊर्ध्व पथम् गत्वा पपात वसुधाम् पुनः ।तत् शंकर शिरो भ्रष्टम् भ्रष्टम् भूमि तले पुनः ॥१-४३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: muhur ūrdhva patham gatvā papāta vasudhām punaḥ ।tat śaṁkara śiro bhraṣṭam bhraṣṭam bhūmi tale punaḥ ॥1-43-25॥

translations.english: The waters of Ganga descended on Shankara's head and from there to the earth. Freed from all impurities, the waters looked pure and clean.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर उन्होंने यथाविधि यज्ञ पूरा किया और अपनी राजधानी को लौट गए। बहुत सोचने पर भी महाराज सगर को गङ्गा जी के लाने का कोई उपाय न सूक पड़ा

verses.sloka: व्यरोचत तदा तोयम् निर्मलम् गत कल्मषम् ।तत्र ऋषि गण गन्धर्वा वसुधा तल वासिनः १-४३-२६भव अंग पतितम् तोयम् पवित्रम् इति पस्पृशुः ।शापात् प्रपतिता ये च गगनात् वसुधा तलम् ॥१-४३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vyarocata tadā toyam nirmalam gata kalmaṣam ।tatra ṛṣi gaṇa gandharvā vasudhā tala vāsinaḥ 1-43-26bhava aṁga patitam toyam pavitram iti paspṛśuḥ ।śāpāt prapatitā ye ca gaganāt vasudhā talam ॥1-43-26॥

translations.english: Considering the waters fallen from the head of Siva sacred, devatas, rishis and gandharvas and those living on earth touched it (with reverence).
translations.hindi: अन्त में तेतीस हजार वर्षों तक राज्य कर वे स्वगेंबासी हुए

verses.sloka: कृत्वा तत्र अभिषेकम् ते बभूवुः गत कल्मषाः ।धूत पापाः पुनः तेन तोयेन अथ शुभ अन्विता ॥१-४३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tatra abhiṣekam te babhūvuḥ gata kalmaṣāḥ ।dhūta pāpāḥ punaḥ tena toyena atha śubha anvitā ॥1-43-27॥

translations.english: Those cursed to fall from heaven to earth were absolved of their sins after bathing there (in the waters of Ganga).

verses.sloka: पुनः आकाशम् आविश्य स्वान् लोकान् प्रतिपेदिरे ।मुमुदे मुदितो लोकः तेन तोयेन भास्वता ॥१-४३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ ākāśam āviśya svān lokān pratipedire ।mumude mudito lokaḥ tena toyena bhāsvatā ॥1-43-28॥

translations.english: Cleansed of their sins by the sparkling waters, they ascended through the sky once again to their own (celestial) worlds.

verses.sloka: कृत अभिषेको गंगायाम् बभूव गत कल्मषः ।भगीरथो राजर्षिः दिव्यम् स्यंदनम् आस्थितः ॥१-४३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta abhiṣeko gaṁgāyām babhūva gata kalmaṣaḥ ।bhagīratho rājarṣiḥ divyam syaṁdanam āsthitaḥ ॥1-43-29॥

translations.english: People rejoiced at the sight of those shining waters. They were happy to have a dip in Ganga and their fatigue was gone.

verses.sloka: प्रायात् अग्रे महाराजाः तम् गंगा पृष्ठतो अन्वगात् ।देवाः स ऋषि गणाः सर्वे दैत्य दानव राक्षसाः ॥१-४३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: prāyāt agre mahārājāḥ tam gaṁgā pṛṣṭhato anvagāt ।devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ sarve daitya dānava rākṣasāḥ ॥1-43-30॥

translations.english: Most brilliant rajarshi Bhagiratha also mounting the divine chariot moved forward and Ganga followed him.

verses.sloka: गन्धर्व यक्ष प्रवराः स किंनर महोरगाः ।सर्पाः च अप्सरसो राम भगीरथ रथ अनुगाः ॥१-४३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: gandharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kiṁnara mahoragāḥ ।sarpāḥ ca apsaraso rāma bhagīratha ratha anugāḥ ॥1-43-31॥

translations.english: O Rama besides acquatic beings, rishis, devatas, daityas, danavas, rakshasas along with kinnaras, serpents, foremost of gandharvas, yakshas and apsaras all followed the chariot of Bhagiratha. They were happy to follow Ganga.

verses.sloka: गंगाम् अन्वगमन् प्रीताः सर्वे जल चराः च ये ।यतो भगीरथो राजा ततो गंगा यशस्विनी ॥१-४३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: gaṁgām anvagaman prītāḥ sarve jala carāḥ ca ye ।yato bhagīratho rājā tato gaṁgā yaśasvinī ॥1-43-32॥

translations.english: O Rama besides acquatic beings, rishis, devatas, daityas, danavas, rakshasas along with kinnaras, serpents, foremost of gandharvas, yakshas and apsaras all followed the chariot of Bhagiratha. They were happy to follow Ganga.

verses.sloka: जगाम सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा सर्व पाप प्रणाशिनी ।ततो हि यजमानस्य जह्नोः अद्भुत कर्मणः ॥१-४३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: jagāma saritām śreṣṭhā sarva pāpa praṇāśinī ।tato hi yajamānasya jahnoḥ adbhuta karmaṇaḥ ॥1-43-33॥

translations.english: Ganga, famous and foremost of rivers, destroyer of all sins, flowed in the direction king Bhagiratha moved.

verses.sloka: गंग संप्लावयामास यज्ञ वाटम् महत्मनः ।तसया वलेपनम् ज्ञत्व कृद्धो जह्नुः च राघव ॥१-४३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: gaṁga saṁplāvayāmāsa yajña vāṭam mahatmanaḥ ।tasayā valepanam jñatva kṛddho jahnuḥ ca rāghava ॥1-43-34॥

translations.english: Then while Ganga was flowing, it inundated the sacrificial ground of the great sage Jahnu. Jahnu who used to work wonders was performing a sacrifice.

verses.sloka: अपिबत् तु जलम् सर्वम् गंगयाः परम अद्भुतम् ।ततो देवाः स गंघर्व ऋषयः च सु विस्मिताः ॥१-४३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: apibat tu jalam sarvam gaṁgayāḥ parama adbhutam ।tato devāḥ sa gaṁgharva ṛṣayaḥ ca su vismitāḥ ॥1-43-35॥

translations.english: O Descendant of the Raghu dynasty sage Jahnu who was performing the sacrifice, observed her pride and grew furious. And astonishingly drank the entire waters of Ganga.

verses.sloka: पूजयन्ति महत्मनम् जह्नुम् पुरुष सत्तमम् ।गंगम् च अपि नयन्ति स्म दुहितृत्वे महात्मनः ॥१-४३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: pūjayanti mahatmanam jahnum puruṣa sattamam ।gaṁgam ca api nayanti sma duhitṛtve mahātmanaḥ ॥1-43-36॥

translations.english: Devatas, rishis and gandharvas stood amazed (at this act). They worshipped the magnanimous Jahnu, noblest among men. The devatas entreated the illustrious Jahnu to treat Ganga as his daughter.

verses.sloka: ततः तुष्टः महातेजाः श्रोत्राभ्याम् असृउजत् प्रभुः ।तस्मात् जह्नु सुता गंग प्रोच्यते जाह्नवी इति च ॥१-४३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tuṣṭaḥ mahātejāḥ śrotrābhyām asṛujat prabhuḥ ।tasmāt jahnu sutā gaṁga procyate jāhnavī iti ca ॥1-43-37॥

translations.english: Devatas, rishis and gandharvas stood amazed (at this act). They worshipped the magnanimous Jahnu, noblest among men. The devatas entreated the illustrious Jahnu to treat Ganga as his daughter.

verses.sloka: जगाम च पुनः गंग भगीरथ रथ अनुगा ।सागरम् च अपि संप्रप्ता सा सरित् प्रवरा तदा ॥१-४३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: jagāma ca punaḥ gaṁga bhagīratha ratha anugā ।sāgaram ca api saṁpraptā sā sarit pravarā tadā ॥1-43-38॥

translations.english: The brilliant (Jahnu) was pleased. He released her through both his both ears. Hence Ganga is called Jahnavi, daughter of Jahnu.

verses.sloka: रसातलम् उपागच्छत् सिद्ध्यर्थम् तस्य कर्मणः ।भगीरथो अपि रजार्षि गंगम् आदाय यत्नतः ॥१-४३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: rasātalam upāgacchat siddhyartham tasya karmaṇaḥ ।bhagīratho api rajārṣi gaṁgam ādāya yatnataḥ ॥1-43-39॥

translations.english: Ganga, best among rivers, following the chariot of Bhagiratha, reached the ocean. She entered the nether regions of the earth in order to fulfil his mission (salvation of the sons of Sagara).

verses.sloka: पितमहान् भस्म क्रुतम् अपश्यत् गत चेतनः ।अथ तत् भस्मनाम् राशिम् गंग सलिलम् उत्तमम् ।प्लावयत् पूत पाप्मानः स्वर्गम् प्रप्ता रघु उत्तम ॥१-४३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: pitamahān bhasma krutam apaśyat gata cetanaḥ ।atha tat bhasmanām rāśim gaṁga salilam uttamam ।plāvayat pūta pāpmānaḥ svargam praptā raghu uttama ॥1-43-40॥

translations.english: Rajarshi Bhagiratha, having brought Ganga with supreme efforts, saw with a sad heart his grandfathers reduced to ashes.
